mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 700K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 700K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 8%, indicating a strong labor market, and payroll employment (PAYEMS) shows a concurrent 3-month increase, the combined effect boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.1) when both conditions are met, in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average, signaling reduced supply chain pressures, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as input costs decrease.
failure_condition: Walk-forward returns do not show significant positive skew (p > 0.05) when INDPRO is below its 6-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: Always, the S&P 500 exhibits a slight positive drift over any 5 trading days due to underlying market momentum, regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns show a statistically significant negative bias (t-test p < 0.01) over any 1-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, indicating a tightening cycle, and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) shows a concurrent 3-month increase above 2%, the combined inflationary pressure leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.1) when both conditions are met, in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 1.5pp in a single month, indicating labor market stress, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending decreases.
failure_condition: Walk-forward returns do not show significant negative skew (p > 0.05) when UNRATE increases by more than 1.5pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 5% over a 3-month period, and housing starts (HOUST) concurrently rise above 600K units, the combined demand boost leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 20d are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.1) when both conditions are met, in > 55% of instances.
